estimates.assumptions: Standard boneless skinless chicken breast is ~200g each; recipe uses 2 breasts (total 400g raw, as bashed to 1cm thick and pan/air-fried without trimming).
½ lemon yields ~30g juice (standard lemon juice weight; calories match known value for lemon juice).
Typical burger buns are ~100g each (total 200g for 2); calories based on average supermarket burger bun density (~280 kcal/100g).
Halloumi (the 'Cheese'); known measurement is exactly 250g as supplied; typical halloumi is ~320 kcal/100g when grilled/air-fried as described.
¼ medium cabbage head ≈250g edible portion (standard weight for ¼ head after removing core); matches supplied known calories for raw cabbage.
2 tbsp mayonnaise ≈30g (standard density); matches supplied known calories.
4 large lettuce/rocket leaves ≈40g total edible portion (standard modest weight for leaves in burgers); matches supplied known calories for lettuce.
2 medium red peppers ≈160g total (80g each, cored and sliced as 'peppers' in recipe); matches supplied known calories for raw red pepper.
